name: WSelector
blurb: WSelector is a modern GTK4/libadwaita application that allows users to browse and set wallpapers from Wallhaven.cc.
description:
WSelector is a modern GTK4/libadwaita application that allows users to browse and set wallpapers from Wallhaven.cc.
It features a clean, responsive interface with support for searching, filtering, and previewing wallpapers before setting them.

Key features include:

• Browse high-quality wallpapers from Wallhaven.cc

• Search functionality with filters

• Smooth infinite scrolling for seamless browsing

• Filter by categories (General, Anime, People)

• Filter by purity (SFW, Sketchy)

• Auto resolution detection

• Drag-to-pan functionality in preview mode

• Support for multiple monitor setups

• Dark/Light theme support

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
